entries.content:
Welcome to Shambleta!
Shambleta is an idle auto battler: your team fights on its own — online or offline.
Pick a farm zone, let your fighter grind, come back later and collect your AFK rewards.
Open chests, gear up, join a guild and climb the seasonal leaderboards.

entries.title: Beta 0.1.0 — The Idle Loop
entries.content:
The idle beta is live!

[ul]Auto-farm: log in and your fighter is already grinding zone 1. Pick deeper zones in the Zone Map window as your power grows.
Offline progress: log out and the farm keeps going — collect your AFK Report when you return.
Chests: earned from AFK settles or bought with gems in the Shop. Public odds, provably fair, with a pity timer.
Gems & Shop: the premium faucet for beta testing (grants only — nothing is sold yet).
VIP: +20% offline faucet while active.
Guilds, Auction House and Seasons: chat-driven for now (/guild, /ah, /season), leaderboards in the Leaderboard window.[/ul]

The world of Aemil is our backdrop: towns and maps from the classic adventure serve as the visual hub while the beta focuses on the idle loop. Adventure quests and dialogues are dormant in this phase.
